notes: The microphone in dialogues now works, and works on every device. Pronunciation is judged on sounds rather than exact words, so a dropped accent, a merged word or one wrong ending no longer reads as a mistake, and all three of the recogniser's guesses are considered instead of only the first. It tries to work offline before reaching for the network. And when a device simply cannot understand the language, which is common for Croatian and European Portuguese, the button stops pretending: it records you instead, so you can play your attempt straight after the model line and hear the difference yourself.
